result:
I’d make basic human security independent of the luck of birth: enough food, a safe place to sleep, medical care, and freedom from violence.

Not because that would settle what makes a good life. It wouldn’t. People would still disagree, grieve, make mistakes, and want different things.

But fewer lives would be spent just trying to survive. More people would have the room to decide what matters to them—and actually pursue it.
